examples.label: Protocol shorthand inside a technical paragraph
examples.source: Every request between the edge and your origin travels over <.component component_name="chelekom-abbr" site="Global" id="abbr-https" title="Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure">HTTPS, and static assets stay in the cache for twenty-four hours before they are revalidated.

examples.label: Billing unit shorthand in a pricing note
examples.source: Object storage is billed at $0.02 per <.component component_name="chelekom-abbr" site="Global" id="abbr-gb" title="Gigabyte" color="primary">GB per month. The first 10 GB on every workspace are free, and we never charge for traffic between your own regions.
